questions.q_en:
Find the missing term in the following series.

ABC, DEF, ___, JKL, MNO
questions.solution_en:
A + 3 = D; B + 3 = E; C + 3 = F

D + 3 = G; E + 3 = H; F + 3 = I

G + 3 = J; H + 3 = K; I + 3 = L

J + 3 = M; K + 3 = N; L + 3 = O

Hence, GHI is the missing term.

G + 3 = J; H + 3 = K; I + 3 = L

J + 3 = M; K + 3 = N; L + 3 = O

Hence, GHI is the missing term.

O + 1 = P; S + 2 = U; W + 3 = Z

Hence, NQT is the missing term.

questions.q_en:
Find the missing term in the following series.

TIME, VGOC, ____, ZCSY, BAUW
questions.solution_en:
T + 2 = V; I - 2 = G; M + 2 = O; E - 2 = C

V + 2 = X; G - 2 = E; O + 2 = Q; C - 2 = A

X + 2 = Z; E - 2 = C; Q + 2 = S; A - 2 = Y

Z + 2 = B; C - 2 = A; S + 2 = U; Y - 2 = W

Hence, XEQA is the missing term.
questions.solution_hi:
T + 2 = V; I - 2 = G; M + 2 = O; E - 2 = C

V + 2 = X; G - 2 = E; O + 2 = Q; C - 2 = A

X + 2 = Z; E - 2 = C; Q + 2 = S; A - 2 = Y

Z + 2 = B; C - 2 = A; S + 2 = U; Y - 2 = W

Hence, XEQA is the missing term.
